title: Day 681 — Colombia Bars Mexico's Military Rescue Brigade, Citing Missing Certification
detail: On August 13, 2026 (Day 681, Thursday), Sheinbaum said Mexico's Agrupamiento Cali military rescue brigade was never allowed to enter Colombia because President Abelardo de la Espriella's government requested an additional certification the Mexican brigade did not hold, despite being certified domestically. Mexico instead continued sending humanitarian goods — 58.5 tonnes of food, medicine, and other essentials via Air Force flights through the week — while independent Mexican volunteer rescue groups reportedly entered Colombia without official coordination.

media.caption: Sheinbaum explains why Mexico's military rescue brigade was barred from entering Colombia

title: Day 681 — AMLO's Son Andy López Beltrán Says US Revoked His Visa, Adding Pressure on Sheinbaum
detail: On August 13, 2026 (Day 681, Thursday), Andrés Manuel 'Andy' López Beltrán — son of former president AMLO — announced via a letter posted to Instagram and addressed to Donald Trump that the U.S. State Department, under Secretary Marco Rubio and Deputy Secretary Christopher Landau, had revoked his U.S. visa. López Beltrán called the move 'political, more propagandistic than anything, in a Hitlerian style' and denied any wrongdoing. The episode increased scrutiny on the Sheinbaum government amid separate PAN questions linking López Beltrán to an FGR fuel-theft ('huachicol fiscal') investigation.

media.caption: Andy López Beltrán announces the US revoked his visa, in a letter addressed to Trump
